ios.desc:
6 Pillars is an app to define, track and reflect periodically on the core pillars of your life that lead to a better version of you.

You can use the default 6 pillars - 'Family, Friends, Health, Wealth, Work & Travel' provided by the app or define your own 6 pillars that you think are important and worth tracking in your life.

At the end of the day, you can assign a value between 1 to 5 to each of these Pillars, with 1 being 'needs attention' and 5 being 'well taken care of'. Along with this rating, you can also add notes or context for these state changes.

You can also scrub across time to get a beautiful visualization of the evolution of the pillars and see which of them are doing good and which need your attention.

The goal of 6 Pillars is to help you to track important aspects of your life, achieve goals and maintain balance.

* FREE FEATURES *

- Manage pillars of your life: Define, track and reflect periodically on the core pillars of your life that lead to a better version of you

- Track impact across time: Scrub across the last 30 days and get an overview on how things have evolved or which pillars of your life need attention

- Journal your thoughts: Add notes for defining moments or changes that affect pillars of your life

- Manage / edit pillars


* PRO FEATURE *

- Time Travel: Go beyond the past 30 days. You can select any year and month and revisit how your life balance looked like then.

- Notes timeline:  View all notes, decisions, thoughts captured along with changes to your life pillars in an easily scrollable timeline

If you like the overall app experience - please add your ratings and reviews so that other people can discover it too.
